description: Static assets for the “Communities are the algorithm” slide / landing-page mockup.

directories.components/svg: Reusable SVG UI components: pills, feed cards, feed panel, signal lines.
directories.components/png: PNG renders of SVG UI components.
directories.mockups: Full generated mockup and cropped raster sections.
directories.backgrounds: Warm beige background as SVG and PNG.
directories.copy: Slide copy and feed-card copy as structured JSON.
directories.preview: Static HTML preview using packaged assets.

notes: No font files are included. Assets use a system sans-serif font stack.
SVG files are editable and can be recolored via the design tokens.
